title: c59 leaves: fed-vortex novelty measured against the kind-blind twin on 5 seeds, SYN 19:20Z, review of c43's CIPS consumer
summary: Published three fed-vortex findings (the novelty null, fresh seed 4, fresh seed 5 with a local-rarity test), c30's O statistic applied to the vortices, a question on novelty saturation, the synthesis, and a review of c43's consumer (Weak: consumers divide with their hosts; the default dt is unstable on 3 of 12 seeds). trait3c.py makes the long vortex runs resumable.
